title: Loci Similes: A Benchmark for Extracting Intertextualities in Latin Literature
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for identifying intertextuality in Late Antique Christian texts (specifically focusing on Church Fathers like Jerome and Lactantius) and their reuse of classical pagan literature. It explicitly deals with the hermeneutics of these transitions and the recontextualization of language within Christian interpretive and theological frameworks.
